text:
ROAD CLOSURE NOTICE

Due to repairs to the Elm Street Bridge, the road will be [1] to all traffic from Monday, July 7, to Friday, July 18. [2] Drivers are advised to use Pine Avenue [3] Highway 9 as alternative routes. Buses on routes 14 and 22 will be rerouted, and passengers can find updated timetables on the city's Web site. We [4] for any inconvenience this may cause.

questions.explanation: The passive 'will be closed' is needed.

choices: The city library will open a new branch.
Parking fees will be reviewed in the fall.
The mayor will attend a conference next week.
Emergency vehicles will be given access at all times.
questions.explanation: The sentence is about the closure and precedes the advice to drivers.
Two alternatives are offered: Pine Avenue or Highway 9.
After the subject 'We', a verb is needed.

text:
Dear all,

I am pleased to announce that Dr. Yuki Tanaka will be joining our research division as Director of Product Development, [1] on April 1. Dr. Tanaka has over fifteen years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and has led teams at several [2] companies. [3] Please join me in welcoming her to Alder Labs. A reception will be held in her honor on her first day, [4] all staff are invited.

Carlos Mendes, CEO

questions.explanation: 'Effective on' a date is the standard way to give a start date.
An adjective is needed before the noun 'companies'.

choices: The cafeteria will serve lunch until 2 p.m.
Under her leadership, we expect to launch three new products next year.
Parking permits must be renewed in January.
Our fiscal year ends in June.
questions.explanation: The sentence states the benefit of her arrival and precedes the welcome.
Two independent clauses are joined: a reception will be held and all staff are invited.

text:
New Seafood Restaurant Opens on Harbor Street

The menu [1] dishes from several coastal regions, [2] grilled octopus, shrimp stew, and fish tacos. [3] Mr. Rivera said he buys all of his fish directly from local fishermen. The restaurant seats 80 guests and is open daily from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Reservations are [4] recommended on weekends.

questions.explanation: A third-person singular present verb follows 'The menu'.
'Including' introduces examples.

choices: The city's marathon will start on Harbor Street.
The mayor opened a new bridge last year.
The restaurant takes pride in the freshness of its ingredients.
Taxi fares have gone up this winter.
questions.explanation: The sentence introduces the topic of fresh ingredients which Mr. Rivera then comments on.
'Highly recommended' is the fixed combination.

text: Learn Spanish with Lingua Academy! Our small classes of no more than eight students [1] you plenty of chances to practice speaking. [2] All of our teachers are native speakers with university degrees in language instruction. Courses are available for beginners [3] advanced learners, and evening and weekend classes can be arranged. Enroll by September 10 to [4] our early-bird discount of 20 percent.

questions.explanation: The plural subject 'classes' takes the plural verb 'give'.

choices: Spanish is spoken in more than twenty countries.
Our building is located next to the post office.
Tuition fees will be increased next year.
Students make rapid progress thanks to our interactive teaching method.
questions.explanation: The sentence praises the teaching and precedes the presentation of the teachers.
'From beginners to advanced learners' expresses a range.
'To receive a discount' is the right verb construction.

text: Hi Marta, it's Dan from the sales office. I'm [1] to let you know that tomorrow's client meeting has moved to 3 p.m. [2] Mr. Hughes has a conflict in the morning. Could you [3] the presentation slides by this evening? I will print the handouts [4] the meeting. Thanks!

questions.explanation: After 'I'm', the present participle is needed.

choices: The office will be closed on Monday.
questions.explanation: The sentence apologizes for the late change, then gives the reason.
One 'sends' slides, meaning to transmit them.
'Before the meeting' sets the order of events.

text:
Small Business Loans

Whether you are starting a new venture or expanding an existing one, Capital Partners can help. Our loans range from $5,000 to $200,000, [1] flexible repayment terms of up to seven years. [2] Applications are reviewed within three business days, and funds are typically released [3] approval. To apply, you will need to provide a business plan and two years of tax records. Applicants who [4] these requirements will be contacted by a loan officer.

questions.explanation: 'With' introduces the features that come with the loans.

choices: There are no hidden fees or early repayment penalties.
Our offices are closed on public holidays.
Interest rates were discussed at the annual meeting.
questions.explanation: The sentence adds a benefit of the loans, before the review process is described.
'Upon approval' means 'as soon as the loan is approved'.
The plural 'Applicants who' takes a plural present verb.

text:
Solar Power Gains Ground in Rural Areas

More farmers are installing solar panels to [1] their electricity bills. According to the Agricultural Energy Bureau, the number of farms using solar power has [2] tripled since 2020. [3] Government subsidies, which cover up to 40 percent of installation costs, have played a major role. Still, some farmers remain hesitant [4] the high upfront cost of the equipment.

questions.explanation: The purpose of solar panels is to 'reduce' bills.
An adverb is needed to modify 'tripled'.

choices: The increase has been especially marked in the last two years.
Fuel is sold at most local stations.
questions.explanation: The sentence describes the increase and precedes the explanation of its cause.
A noun phrase ('the high upfront cost') follows, so a preposition is needed.

text:
MEMO
To: Department managers

Each manager will be given a [3] budget, which cannot be exceeded without prior approval. Training sessions on how to use the portal [4] on September 22 and 23.

questions.explanation: 'Through the portal' expresses the means used.

choices: The warehouse will be painted in October.
New chairs will arrive on Friday.
Paper order forms will no longer be accepted.
The annual report is available in the library.
questions.explanation: The sentence states the change, which 'This change' then refers to.
An adjective is needed before 'budget'.
The sessions do not hold anything: the passive is needed.
